Isicwangciso sokwahlula: Yahlula ipotifoliyo yotyalo-mali ibe ngamasebe exesha elifutshane (imali, iminyaka engu-1-3), exesha eliphakathi (amabhondi kunye neempahla zengeniso, iminyaka engu-3-7), kunye nexesha elide (izabelo, iminyaka engu-7+). Buyisela isigcina-mali sexesha elifutshane kwisithuba sexesha eliphakathi xa iimakethi zinyukile.

3. Ukutsalwa okuguquguqukayo: Nciphisa ukutsala kwiinyaka ezimbi (chitha kancinci, tsala kancinci). Nokuba kuncitshiswa nge-10% kokutsalwa unyaka owohlwayayo kwandisa ixesha lokuphila kwipotifoliyo.

4. I-annuity ephilayo vs i-annuity eqinisekisiweyo: I-annuity eqinisekisiweyo itshintshela umngcipheko wolandelelwano kumboneleli ngenxa yokunikezela ngenkunzi. I-annuity ephilayo igcina ukuguquguquka kodwa iveza umhlala-phantsi kumngcipheko wolandelelwano. Abacebisi abaninzi bacebisa ukuxuba.

<p><strong>1. EBITDA Multiple (earnings-:
1. EBITDA Multiple (imivuzo-based):Eyona ixhaphakileyo kumashishini asebenzayo. Ixabiso = EBITDA × imboni ezininzi. Ii-multiples ze-SA SME zivela kwi-2-5× EBITDA (vs 8-15× kwiinkampani ezidwelisiweyo). Ifemu yobunjineli enengeniso ene-R2m EBITDA inokuthengisa nge-R6-8m (3-4× EBITDA). Izinto ezandisa ubuninzi: ingeniso ephindaphindiweyo, isiseko sabathengi abahlukeneyo, iqela lolawulo lingaxhomekekanga kumnini, umkhondo wokukhula olomeleleyo.

2. Isaphulelo semali eSetyenzisiweyo (DCF):Iprojekthi yexesha elizayo yokuhamba kwemali esimahla, isaphulelo sibuyele ngexabiso elihlengahlengisiweyo (WACC). Ichaneke ngakumbi ngokwethiyori kodwa ivakalelo kakhulu kwiintelekelelo. Isetyenziswa kakhulu kumashishini amakhulu okanye ngabacebisi bezezimali ngexesha lokunyamekela.

3. Ixabiso le-Asethi eNtengiso (NAV): Ii-asethi thabatha amatyala kwixabiso lemarike. Isetyenziselwa amashishini anzima (iinkampani zepropathi, imigodi, imveliso). Ngokuqhelekileyo ixabiso lomgangatho, inkxalabo ehambayo kufuneka ixabise ngaphezu kwamalungu ayo.
<p><strong>1. Harvesting losses:</strong:
1. Ilahleko zokuvuna:Ukuba unelahleko engafanelekanga kwipotifoliyo yakho, ziqonde ngonyaka ofanayo werhafu njengenzuzo enkulu. Ilahleko yokulinganisa izuza irandi-ngerandi phambi kokuba kusebenze izinga lokubandakanywa.

2. Ukusabalalisa ukulahlwa kwiminyaka yerhafu:Ukukhutshwa konyaka kukusebenzisa-okanye-ukulahlekelwa yiyo. Ukuba uceba ukuthengisa indawo enkulu, intengiso ekhwankqisayo kwiminyaka emininzi isebenzisa ii-R40 000 ezingabandakanywayo ezininzi.

3. TFSA usonga:Ii-asethi ezingaphakathi kwiAkhawunti yogcino lweRhafu engenaRhafu ayinayo CGT, naphakade. Ukubamba ii-asethi zokukhula (equity ETFs) kwiTFSA yakho kuphelisa ngokusisigxina i-CGT kwezo asethi.

4. Umnikelo kwi-PBO: Ukunikela nge-asethi exatyisiweyo ngokuthe ngqo kwiCandelo le-18A lombutho woncedo loluntu akuxhomekekanga kwi-CGT kwaye kutsalwa irhafu ukuya kuthi ga kwi-10% yengeniso erhafiswayo.
<p><strong>1. Inter vivos trust:</strong:
1. I-Inter vivos trust:Dlulisa ii-asethi ezixabisayo kwi-trust ngoku. Ukukhula kwexesha elizayo kuwela ngaphandle kwempahla yakho. Utshintshiselwano luxhokonxa i-CGT ngoku (ixabiso lexesha elinye) kodwa isusa ukukhula okuqhubekayo kwizibalo zemisebenzi yezindlu.

2. Isiqinisekiso soBomi (Icandelo 3(3)(a)):Ipolisi yobomi apho ilifa lingumxhamli liqukiwe kwi-dutiable estate kodwa i-inshurensi ihlawula umsebenzi. Le migaqo-nkqubo yakhelwe ukuhlawulela umrhumo wezindlu, iipremiyamu zihlawula kwangaphambili ngokufanelekileyo umrhumo wempahla yakho ngezavenge.

3. Izithembiso zeqabane lomtshato ukuze kukhule ukuphatheka kakuhle:Ukwenza umyolelo wakho ukuze ilifa elipheleleyo liye kwiqabane lakho lirhoxisa wonke umsebenzi wokufa kwesibini, ngelo xesha ukubulawa kwabantu kusenokuba sele kutshintshile, okanye ilifa leqabane elisaphilayo linokwakhiwa ngokwahlukileyo.

4. Izipho ngexesha lokuphila:Izipho ezifikelela kwi-R100 000 ngonyaka azihlawulelwa kwiRhafu yeMinikelo. Ngaphezulu kweminyaka engama-20, izigidi ezi-R2 zinokukhutshelwa ngaphandle kwempahla yakho, konga ama-R400 000 kumsebenzi wezindlu.
<p><strong>1. Sole Proprietor:</strong>:
1. Sole Proprietor:Akukho kwahlukana phakathi kwakho kunye neshishini. Zonke iingeniso ezirhafiswa njengengeniso yomntu (ukuya kuma-45%). Uxanduva lomntu olungenamkhawulo. Zero iindleko zokuseta. Isebenza kubantu abazimeleyo phantsi kwengeniso ye-R1m.

2. Inkampani yabucala (Pty Ltd): Yahlula iziko elisemthethweni. 27% izinga lerhafu yenkampani. Ukukhuselwa koxanduva lomntu (ulinganiselwe). Ifuna ubhaliso lwe-CIPC. Ilungele amashishini angaphezulu kwe-R500k yengeniso.

3. Umboneleli weNkonzo yoMntu (PSP):A Pty Ltd apho i-80% + yengeniso ivela kwiinkonzo kumthengi omnye okanye ababini. I-SARS irhafisa ii-PSP ngereyithi ye-28-45% (hayi i-27% yereyithi yoshishino), lo ngumgibe iikontraka ezininzi eziwela kuwo.

4. I-Small Business Corporation (SBC):I-Pty Ltd ifanelekele ukuthotywa amaxabiso erhafu. Ingeniso epheleleyo engaphantsi kwe-R20 yezigidi. Akukho mnini sabelo uvumelekileyo ukuba abe nezabelo kwenye inkampani. Umyinge werhafu: 0% okokuqala kwi-R95 750, ize ibe yi-7% -27% kwimigangatho. Kwii-SME ezifanelekileyo, oku konga irhafu eninzi.

<p><strong>Included in your estate (duti:
Included in your estate (dutiable):

  • Property, vehicles, investments in your name
  • Business interests (shares in Pty Ltd, partnership interest)
  • Retirement funds, only the after-tax lump sum amount payable to your estate (not nominated beneficiaries)
  • Life insurance policies where the estate is the beneficiary

Excluded from your estate:

  • Retirement fund proceeds paid to nominated beneficiaries (not the estate), these bypass estate duty entirely
  • Life policies payable to nominated beneficiaries (Section 3(3)(a) policies on which estate duty has already been accounted for)
  • Assets in a properly established inter vivos trust (owned by the trust, not you)

Beneficiary nominations on your pension, provident fund, and RA are therefore estate planning tools, not just administrative forms.

<p>A trust is not a company and not a pe:

<p>A unit trust pools money from many in:

<p>An overdraft allows you to spend beyo: I-ovadrafti ikuvumela ukuba uchithe ngaphaya kwebhalansi yakho ukuya kumda ovunyiweyo. <p>An overdraft lets you spend past zero: I-ovadrafti ikuvumela ukuba uchithe ixesha elidlule elinguziro kwi-prime + 5–8%, kunye nenzala eyongezelekayo mihla le, efana okanye embi kakhulu kunekhadi letyala. <p>Bank fees are silent killers. Common:

<p>Base cost is what you paid for the as:

Ii-asethi zomhla woqikelelo lwangaphambili: Ukuba ubune-asethi phambi kwe-1 Oktobha 2001 (umhla wokungeniswa kwe-CGT), isiseko sexabiso sinokumiselwa kusetyenziswa ixabiso lemarike ngaloo mhla, kungekhona ixabiso lokuqala lokuthenga. Oku kudla ngokunciphisa ngokumangalisayo iinzuzo kwizabelo okanye kwipropathi ekudala ikho.

Into elindelwe nguSARS: Gcina onke amanqaku ekhontrakthi (urhwebo lwezabelo), iirisithi zerhafu yokudluliselwa, ii-invoyisi zokuphucula, kunye nezivumelwano zomenzeli wezindlu ngokusisigxina. U-SARS unokuphicotha iminyaka emi-5 umva kodwa akanaxesha lisikelwe ukubuyiswa kobuqhophololo. Ibhokisi yezihlangu engenazirekhodi lityala lerhafu elilindele ukwenzeka.

Ngo-2020-2021, iireyithi zokwenyani zoMzantsi Afrika zazikufutshane no-zero okanye zingalunganga, imali yayiphulukene nexabiso ngokuthe cwaka.
